subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The loudest opinion is not always the majority.”?
options: Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.
When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.
The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
People should know what they are giving when they choose it.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Some small objects help people rest because they hold a quiet world that does not hurry.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The loudest opinion is not always the majority. When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「People should know what they are giving when they choose it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The loudest opinion is not always the majority. When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.」，答案為「When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「When people have a quiet way to choose, the result may surprise you.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
